basis.zh: 任务要求根据观测执行游戏操作，并以实际完成或回报评价。
basis.en: The task requires observation-conditioned game actions evaluated by completion or return.

evidence.excerpt: Sections 3.1 and 4 specify screen-video input and keyboard/mouse actions. Four game evaluations use task success, cleared tiles, trading profits and city-service/population metrics, with human-assisted city results separate.

task.zh: 13 个剧情任务与购买补给任务，涉及跟随、搜索和战斗。
task.en: Thirteen story tasks and a supply-purchase task involving following, search and combat.

observation.zh: 上一操作的屏幕视频（2 fps）及任务提示。
observation.en: Screen video of the previous action at 2 fps and task instructions.

action.zh: Python 执行键盘按下/保持/释放及鼠标移动、点击和滚轮。
action.en: Python-executed key presses, holds and releases, mouse motion, clicks and scrolling.

metrics.zh: 各任务成功率。
metrics.en: Per-task success rate.

controls.zh: 默认五次运行；各任务最多 500 步，失败或死亡可重试检查点。
controls.en: Five runs by default; five hundred steps per task with checkpoint retry on failure or death.

limits.zh: 重试和模型调用期间游戏暂停策略影响成绩；不是整部游戏通关率。
limits.en: Retries and pausing around model calls affect outcomes; this is not full-game completion.

basis.zh: 任务要求根据观测执行游戏操作，并以实际完成或回报评价。
basis.en: The task requires observation-conditioned game actions evaluated by completion or return.

basis.zh: 种植须跨多日维持目标并最终收获。
basis.en: Cultivation maintains an objective across days until harvest.

evidence.title: Cradle: Empowering Foundation Agents towards General Computer Control
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3.1 and 4 specify screen-video input and keyboard/mouse actions. Four game evaluations use task success, cleared tiles, trading profits and city-service/population metrics, with human-assisted city results separate.

task.zh: 清除农场障碍，连续照料并收获防风草，完成购物。
task.en: Clear farm obstacles, tend and harvest parsnips, and shop.

observation.zh: 上一操作的屏幕视频（2 fps）及任务提示。
observation.en: Screen video of the previous action at 2 fps and task instructions.

action.zh: Python 执行键盘按下/保持/释放及鼠标移动、点击和滚轮。
action.en: Python-executed key presses, holds and releases, mouse motion, clicks and scrolling.

metrics.zh: 清理格数及种植/购物任务成功次数。
metrics.en: Cleared tiles and successful cultivation/shopping trials.

controls.zh: 五次运行，每任务最多 100 步；种植涉及四天照料。
controls.en: Five runs and one hundred steps per task; cultivation spans four days of care.

limits.zh: 不同任务指标不可直接相加，天数不等同低层控制步数。
limits.en: Task metrics are heterogeneous; game days are not low-level control steps.

basis.zh: 有限经营周期内以报价和交易选择优化成交与利润。
basis.en: Pricing and trade choices balance turnover and profit within a limited shop period.

evidence.title: Cradle: Empowering Foundation Agents towards General Computer Control

task.zh: 评估物品并向顾客议价，经营店铺一周。
task.en: Evaluate goods, haggle with customers and run a shop for one week.

observation.zh: 上一操作的屏幕视频（2 fps）及任务提示。
observation.en: Screen video of the previous action at 2 fps and task instructions.

action.zh: Python 执行键盘按下/保持/释放及鼠标移动、点击和滚轮。
action.en: Python-executed key presses, holds and releases, mouse motion, clicks and scrolling.

metrics.zh: 平均议价次数、成交率、单件利润率及总利润率。
metrics.en: Haggling count, turnover, item profit rate and total profit rate.

controls.zh: 五次运行，固定一周经营任务。
controls.en: Five runs of the one-week management task.

limits.zh: 模拟顾客的价格交互不等同自由语言谈判；具体种子仍需固定。
limits.en: Price interaction with simulated customers is not free-form language negotiation; seeds remain to be fixed.

basis.zh: 道路和水管连通、设施服务覆盖与分区布局有显式判据。
basis.en: Road/pipe connectivity, service coverage and zoning layout have explicit criteria.

evidence.title: Cradle: Empowering Foundation Agents towards General Computer Control

task.zh: 建设闭环道路、供水、供电和分区，发展人口。
task.en: Build connected roads, water, power and zoning to grow population.

observation.zh: 上一操作的屏幕视频（2 fps）及任务提示。
observation.en: Screen video of the previous action at 2 fps and task instructions.

action.zh: Python 执行键盘按下/保持/释放及鼠标移动、点击和滚轮。
action.en: Python-executed key presses, holds and releases, mouse motion, clicks and scrolling.

metrics.zh: 道路闭环、充分供水/供电、分区覆盖率及最大人口；辅助与自主结果分开。
metrics.en: Road closure, adequate water/power, zoning coverage and peak population; assisted results are separate.

controls.zh: 五次运行，最多 1000 步或资金耗尽；人工辅助最多三次单元操作另报。
controls.en: Five runs, up to one thousand steps or budget exhaustion; up to three human corrections reported separately.

limits.zh: 仅基础城市方案；人工辅助人口不能作为自主能力。
limits.en: Foundational city building only; human-assisted population is not autonomous ability.

evidence.title: AI Gamestore: Scalable, Open-Ended Evaluation of Machine General Intelligence with Human Games
evidence.excerpt: The benchmark evaluates 100 AI-generated games inspired by App Store and Steam titles under a common short-play interface.

taskReview.noteZh: 全文和附录确认100游戏共同交互协议、120次调用预算和人类归一化指标；只登记集合协议，不向各游戏复制认知能力标签。 本轮归属复核：保留100个生成实现的键盘交互协议；App Store/Steam游戏是生成灵感来源，不能将原作名称直接视为评测对象。
taskReview.noteEn: Full text and appendices establish the common 100-game protocol, 120-call budget and human-normalized metrics; only the suite protocol is registered. Routing review: Retain the keyboard protocol for 100 generated implementations; App Store/Steam source titles are inspirations, not the evaluated originals.

bibliography.name: GameVerse
bibliography.title: GameVerse: Can Vision-Language Models Learn from Video-based Reflection?
bibliography.authors: Kuan Zhang; Dongchen Liu; Qiyue Zhao; Jinkun Hou; Xinran Zhang; Qinlei Xie; Miao Liu; Yiming Li

basis.zh: 实测 VLM 读取游戏视频，反思失败并结合专家教程重试；这属于无训练反思，不据类比措辞推断 RL/IL。
basis.en: Evaluated VLMs watch game videos and reflect/retry using failures and tutorials; the training-free analogy does not establish RL or imitation-policy training.

agentReview.noteZh: 已按原始来源核验上述标签；仅确认有直接证据的模型/学习方式及对应角色，不声称穷尽兼容性或独立复现。
agentReview.noteEn: The listed model/training paradigms and their roles have direct primary-source support; confirmation is not exhaustive compatibility or independent reproduction.

task.zh: 通过滑动合并数字并避免棋盘堵塞
task.en: Merge tiles by sliding and avoid board gridlock

observation.zh: 当前截图及上一步视觉—动作对
observation.en: Current screenshot and preceding vision-action pair

action.zh: GUI方向按键；语义模式另行报告
action.en: GUI directional keypresses; semantic mode reported separately

metrics.zh: 每局合并分数相对形成2048的参考分数归一化后平均，附标准差
metrics.en: Mean merge score normalized to the reference for forming a 2048 tile, with standard deviation

controls.zh: 表1为5测试/10分钟；附录D.3每局最多1000步；有/无视频反思分开比较
controls.en: Table 1: five tests/10 minutes; appendix D.3 caps episodes at 1000 steps; reflection and no-reflection conditions reported separately

limits.zh: 只核验2048，不继承15游戏的统一能力标签；随机新砖带来方差
limits.en: 2048 only; no capability propagation across all 15 games; stochastic tile spawns introduce variance

basis.zh: 为后续合并维护空间并提前避免堵塞
basis.en: Preserve board space for subsequent merges and prevent gridlock

evidence.title: GameVerse: Can Vision-Language Models Learn from Video-based Reflection?
evidence.excerpt: Merge tiles by sliding and avoid board gridlock Metrics: Mean merge score normalized to the reference for forming a 2048 tile, with standard deviation

basis.zh: 表2逐一列出15款游戏、试验次数和GUI/语义动作模式；§3.2与附录D描述执行动作后的反思重试、原生分数或里程碑评价。此处确认这些游戏在论文中的闭环任务用途，不把视频教程或离线里程碑标注另算成离线评测，也不表示本站已运行。
basis.en: Table 2 names all 15 games and their GUI/semantic modes; Sections 3.2–3.3 and Appendix D document action-driven reflect-and-retry trials with native or milestone scoring. This establishes interactive-task use, not a separate static benchmark from tutorial videos or milestone annotation; no execution is verified here.

task.zh: 连续采矿达到配置的资源数量目标
task.en: Repeatedly mine until a configured resource-count target is reached

observation.zh: 截图及最近动作历史
observation.en: Screenshots and recent action history

action.zh: 键鼠控制或语义动作解析；移动、瞄准、持续采矿
action.en: Keyboard/mouse or semantic action parsing; move, aim and hold to mine

metrics.zh: 状态校验的成功率与预算内最大归一化进度
metrics.en: State-verified success and maximum normalized progress within budget

controls.zh: 同任务目标、100动作预算，单动作固定执行时长；推理时暂停，实时测试单独报告。
controls.en: Same task target, 100 actions, fixed per-action duration; pause during inference, separate real-time tests.

limits.zh: 是浏览器 Minecraft 克隆；不能把达到 90% 进度算作完成
limits.en: A browser Minecraft clone; 90% progress is not completion

basis.zh: 必须持续推进数量目标直到闭环完成
basis.en: Sustain progress until the resource target is completed

basis.zh: 需正确保持瞄准和采矿动作
basis.en: Maintain correct aiming and mining actions

evidence.excerpt: Repeatedly mine until a configured resource-count target is reached; measures: State-verified success and maximum normalized progress within budget.

observation.en: Game screenshots and action history

action.zh: 等待或拍翅的按键操作

metrics.en: State-verified success rate and normalized score progress

controls.en: Same task target, 100 actions, fixed per-action duration; pause during inference, separate real-time tests.

evidence.excerpt: Section 3.4 and online results identify Minecraft only: 20 long tasks and 62 subtasks, with resets to successful states after failure. The 21-game scope belongs to data/offline questions. Per-task action budgets and a complete online action interface remain unlocated, so no capability unit is spread across 21 games.

followup.noteZh: 全文3.4与在线结果表确认在线轨道仅Minecraft：20长任务、62短子任务，失败后重置为成功状态继续；21游戏属于数据及离线题目覆盖。尚未从本次读到的协议定位每任务动作预算和完整在线动作接口，保留partial，不生成泛化到21游戏的能力单元。

controls.en: Report fifty-millisecond IsoTime and one-thousand-simulation IsoSim separately, against fifteen baseline algorithms.

limits.zh: 泛化对象是搜索程序而非直接输出动作的聊天模型；这里只挂六款明确棋盘子集。
limits.en: Transfer concerns search programs, not a conversational model directly emitting actions; only the six named board games are linked.

basis.zh: 正文§4.3、附录F/表11明确19款留出OpenSpiel游戏（包括Sky Blocks与Solitaire）；附录G另述360个生成C++环境。它们通过合法动作、状态转移与终局收益接口进行搜索对局和SCO/AlphaRank评价；不是仅静态规则资料。此处只确认交互用途，Sky Blocks与Solitaire具体变体规则仍未据此补造。
basis.en: Section 4.3, Appendix F/Table 11 identify the 19 held-out OpenSpiel games, including Sky Blocks and Solitaire; Appendix G adds 360 generated C++ environments. Search is evaluated through legal-action, transition and terminal-return APIs using SCO/AlphaRank. This establishes interactive use, while exact Sky Blocks and Solitaire variant rules remain unresolved.

task.zh: 采用 Orak 的 StarCraft II 完整 1v1 对局，对手为固定配置的游戏 AI。
task.en: Use Orak’s full StarCraft II 1v1 match against a game AI with a fixed configuration.

observation.zh: 通过 Orak 的游戏状态与动作工具交互；具体模态、查询间隔和动作批量须固定。
observation.en: Use Orak’s game-state and action tools; pin modality, query interval and action batching.

action.zh: 通过 Orak 的游戏状态与动作工具交互；具体模态、查询间隔和动作批量须固定。
action.en: Use Orak’s game-state and action tools; pin modality, query interval and action batching.

metrics.zh: 文档指标：胜率。Arena 建议补充：资源利用、发展阶段、决策延迟和停滞轨迹；须先验证记录器。
metrics.en: Documented measure: win rate. Proposed diagnostics: resource use, development stages, latency and stalls; recorders need validation.

controls.zh: 固定地图、双方种族、AI 难度与风格、决策频率和预算；不与 SMACv2 微操胜率混合。
controls.en: Fix map, races, AI difficulty/style, decision frequency and budget. Do not pool this win rate with SMACv2 micromanagement.

limits.zh: 需安装游戏、固定配置并验证 Orak 适配；仓库中 SC2 的 MCP 路线仍标注开发中。
limits.en: Game installation, pinned configuration and adapter validation are required; the SC2 MCP path is marked work in progress.

basis.zh: 经济、生产、科技与战斗需要共同取舍，补充微操任务无法覆盖的宏观决策。
basis.en: Economy, production, technology and combat create trade-offs beyond micromanagement scenarios.

label.zh: 我的世界 · 合成依赖

task.zh: Orak Minecraft 合成目标中，选石镐作为首个候选目标；后续可增加更长依赖链。
task.en: Select a stone pickaxe goal from Orak’s Minecraft crafting tasks as the initial candidate; longer dependency chains can follow.

observation.zh: Orak 的 Minecraft 工具与代码/技能执行层；须披露技能库和初始状态。
observation.en: Orak’s Minecraft tools and code/skill execution layer; disclose skill libraries and initial state.

action.zh: Orak 的 Minecraft 工具与代码/技能执行层；须披露技能库和初始状态。
action.en: Orak’s Minecraft tools and code/skill execution layer; disclose skill libraries and initial state.

metrics.zh: 记录所选目标的完成率；Orak 全套 8 目标的汇总定义不直接用于一个目标的运行。
metrics.en: Report completion for the selected goal; Orak’s eight-goal aggregate does not apply to a single-goal run.

controls.zh: 固定世界、初始背包、目标、可用技能与预算；与 MineDojo 底层控制任务分开报告。
controls.en: Fix world, initial inventory, goal, available skills and budget; report separately from low-level MineDojo tasks.

limits.zh: 需固定具体目标配置、技能库及目标检测器，安装游戏与适配器。
limits.en: Pin goal configuration, skill library and goal detector; install the game and adapter.

basis.zh: 在开放世界中检查资源与合成依赖，可与规则封闭的汉诺塔互补。技能库会改变实际规划难度。
basis.en: Resource and crafting dependencies complement Hanoi’s closed rules. Skill libraries change the effective planning difficulty.

label.zh: 代码技能 · 制作目标 · 依赖执行
label.en: Code skills · Crafting targets · Prerequisite execution

task.zh: 按 success_condition 配置制作目标。官方汇总指标列出 8 个目标，包括工作台、石镐、熔炉、水桶、金剑、钻石镐、附魔台与下界传送门。
task.en: Crafting targets configured by success_condition. The documented aggregate covers eight targets: crafting table, stone pickaxe, furnace, bucket, golden sword, diamond pickaxe, enchanting table and nether portal.

observation.zh: 文本状态包含生物群系、附近方块与实体、生命、饥饿、位置、装备、库存及箱子信息。
observation.en: Text state includes biome, nearby blocks/entities, health, hunger, position, equipment, inventory and chests.

action.zh: 生成 JavaScript 异步函数，调用提供的控制技能。
action.en: Generate asynchronous JavaScript functions using provided control skills.

metrics.zh: 官方汇总：完成的制作目标数 / 8 × 100。单任务 evaluator 按配置目标检查装备或库存；与汇总指标分开记录。
metrics.en: Documented aggregate: completed crafting targets / 8 × 100. The single-task evaluator checks configured targets in equipment or inventory; record it separately from the aggregate.

controls.zh: 制作目标、初始世界与库存、技能库、代码执行限制、提示词及调用预算。
controls.en: Crafting target, initial world/inventory, skill library, code-execution constraints, prompts and inference budget.

limits.zh: 下界传送门目标如何对应通用库存检查尚未确认；未固定提交，安装与运行成本未核验。
limits.en: How the nether-portal target maps to the generic inventory check remains unresolved. No pinned commit; installation and running costs unverified.

basis.zh: 适合研究代码技能调用与制作目标执行；与 MineDojo 低层动作或 SmartPlay 导航的分数不可直接互换。
basis.en: Useful for code-skill use and crafting-goal execution; scores are not interchangeable with MineDojo low-level control or SmartPlay navigation.

label.zh: 完整对局 · 高层策略动作

task.zh: 完整 1v1 对内置 AI 的对局；示例配置为 Protoss 对 Zerg，不据此推定覆盖所有种族。
task.en: Full 1v1 matches against a built-in AI; the example config is Protoss versus Zerg, which does not establish coverage of all races.

observation.zh: 文本摘要包含资源、建筑、单位、科研、进行中动作及敌人信息；源码另有可选图像输入。
observation.en: Text summaries include resources, buildings, units, research, ongoing actions and enemy information; the implementation also has optional image input.

action.zh: 从预定义的高层动作词典中选择动作。
action.en: Choose actions from a predefined high-level action dictionary.

metrics.zh: 对 AI bot 的胜场 / 总场次 × 100。与 SMACv2 微操胜率的评估单位不同。
metrics.en: Wins against the AI bot / total matches × 100. The evaluation unit differs from SMACv2 micromanagement win rate.

controls.zh: 地图、双方种族、AI 难度与风格、查询间隔、动作批量、观测模态及模型预算。
controls.en: Map, player/opponent races, AI difficulty/style, query interval, action batch, observation modality and model budget.

limits.zh: MCP 模式完成度、安装兼容性与实际运行成本未核验；未固定提交或复现实验。
limits.en: MCP-mode readiness, installation compatibility and actual running costs remain unverified; no pinned commit or independent reproduction.

basis.zh: 适合研究高层策略动作与完整对局执行；与 SMACv2 比较时应对照研究范围，而非直接比较胜率。
basis.en: Useful for high-level strategic actions and full-match execution. Compare research scope with SMACv2 rather than ranking their win rates.

paragraphs.zh: BALROG 将 BabyAI、Crafter、TextWorld、Baba Is AI、MiniHack 和 NetHack 纳入统一的观测—动作评测框架，任务涵盖指令执行、规则解谜、资源获取和地牢探索。
paragraphs.en: BALROG unifies observation–action evaluation across BabyAI, Crafter, TextWorld, Baba Is AI, MiniHack and NetHack, spanning instructions, rule puzzles, resource acquisition and dungeon exploration.

paragraphs.zh: 用于比较 LLM 与 VLM 的持续决策表现，并研究提示策略、历史窗口和观测模态对多阶段任务进展的影响。
paragraphs.en: It compares sustained decision making in LLMs and VLMs and supports studies of prompting, history windows and observation modality in multistage tasks.

paragraphs.zh: 各环境按任务成功或进展定义计算得分，再汇总为总体表现。分环境成绩呈现模型在不同任务机制与难度下的表现分布。
paragraphs.en: Environment-specific success or progress measures are aggregated into an overall score. Per-environment results characterize performance across task mechanisms and difficulty levels.

paragraphs.zh: 评测范围为六类游戏中的交互决策，涉及探索、控制、记忆等相互关联的过程。具体实验由环境任务、交互预算及输入设置确定。
paragraphs.en: The scope is interactive decision making across six environments, involving coupled exploration, control and memory processes. Tasks, interaction budgets and input settings define each experiment.

action.zh: 回答中间子问题并给出执行动作。

controls.en: 20 matches per model pair, ten first-player seats each; 4,096 output tokens; random baseline.

limits.zh: 人为CoT策略提示参与性能；中间推理分不是自由推理的客观全能力测量。
limits.en: Prescriptive strategy/CoT prompts affect performance; intermediate scores do not measure unrestricted reasoning.

basis.zh: 对抗结果反映规则内的动作选择与收益。

task.zh: 从 SmartPlay 汉诺塔开始，采用三盘任务作为首个候选配置。

observation.zh: 文本状态与规则说明；通过环境规定的移动动作操作圆盘。
observation.en: Text state and rules; move disks through the environment’s action interface.

action.zh: 文本状态与规则说明；通过环境规定的移动动作操作圆盘。

metrics.zh: 任务指标：完成情况。Arena 建议补充：合法移动数、无效动作及相对于最短解的额外步数。
metrics.en: Task measure: completion. Proposed Arena diagnostics: legal moves, invalid actions and excess steps over an optimal solution.

controls.zh: 固定盘数、初始位置、动作预算、规则与历史可见范围；明确是否允许外部求解器。
controls.en: Fix disk count, initial state, action budget, rules and visible history; declare any external solver access.

limits.zh: 需核对当前实现配置并固定版本；SmartPlay 仓库已归档，安装可用性待验证。

label.zh: 双臂老虎机 · 交互学习

task.zh: SmartPlay 双臂老虎机：收益概率未知，通过多轮选择获取反馈。
task.en: SmartPlay’s two-armed bandit: infer unknown reward probabilities through repeated choices and feedback.

observation.zh: 文本历史、每轮动作和收益反馈；选择两臂之一。
observation.en: Text history, per-round choices and reward feedback; select one of two arms.

action.zh: 文本历史、每轮动作和收益反馈；选择两臂之一。
action.en: Text history, per-round choices and reward feedback; select one of two arms.

metrics.zh: 任务指标：累计收益。Arena 建议补充：已知生成概率下的遗憾值与选择比例，需明确定义估计方式。
metrics.en: Task measure: cumulative reward. Proposed additions: regret under known generation probabilities and arm-choice ratios, with explicit estimators.

controls.zh: 固定轮数、概率差、收益幅度和反馈格式；随机交换臂顺序并匹配随机种子。
controls.en: Fix rounds, probability gap, reward magnitude and feedback format; randomize arm ordering and match seeds.

limits.zh: 需固定具体概率配置、轮数和随机数协议；仓库已归档，运行依赖待验证。
limits.en: Pin probabilities, rounds and random-number protocol; the repository is archived and runtime dependencies are unverified.

label.zh: 空间导航 · 语言观测 · 探索

task.zh: 寻找指定生物群系的简化导航任务；不覆盖制作技术树或完整生存流程。
task.en: Simplified navigation to a specified biome; does not cover crafting progression or full survival.

observation.zh: 将视觉世界转换为文本描述，并提供任务说明与历史信息。
observation.en: The visual world is converted to textual descriptions, with task instructions and history.

action.zh: LLM 从 4 类动作中选择，由手写控制器执行。
action.en: The LLM chooses among four action categories, executed by a hand-coded controller.

metrics.zh: 找到目标生物群系的完成指示值与完成率；按本游戏报告。
metrics.en: Completion indicator and completion rate for finding the target biome; report this game separately.

controls.zh: 原论文协议：历史长度 2、rollout 200、20 次试验。这些是论文设置，不代表当前代码默认值。
controls.en: Paper protocol: history length 2, rollout 200, and 20 trials. These are paper settings, not verified current code defaults.

bibliography.name: GROOT-2
bibliography.title: GROOT-2: Weakly Supervised Multi-Modal Instruction Following Agents
bibliography.authors: Shaofei Cai; Bowei Zhang; Zihao Wang; Haowei Lin; Xiaojian Ma; Anji Liu; Yitao Liang

basis.zh: 策略将视觉历史与语言/视频条件映射到动作；constrained self-imitating 与少量标注示范对齐共同训练。
basis.en: An integrated policy maps visual histories and language/video conditions to actions, using constrained self-imitation and alignment on labeled demonstrations.

task.zh: 100 项战斗、狩猎、骑乘、繁殖、合成、采矿、交互、种植任务。
task.en: 100 tasks across eight interaction families.

observation.zh: 游戏画面及语言或参考视频。
observation.en: Game images plus language or reference video.

action.zh: 原生键鼠控制。
action.en: Native keyboard/mouse controls.

metrics.zh: 按任务族平均成功率。
metrics.en: Mean success rate per task family.

controls.zh: 每任务 30 次，3 个种子；比较提示模态。
controls.en: 30 trials per task across three seeds; compare prompt modalities.

limits.zh: 指令执行协议；不自动推断独立记忆或规划能力。
limits.en: Instruction-following protocol; no independent memory/planning inference.

basis.zh: 按指令执行实体交互并用成功率计分。
basis.en: Object interaction is scored by task success.

evidence.title: GROOT-2 — Table 1 and Appendices B–C; local author PDF
evidence.excerpt: Minecraft uses 100 tasks in eight families, language/video prompts, keyboard/mouse controls and repeated success-rate evaluation; Atari uses return-conditioned rollouts.

label.zh: Atari 回报水平指令执行

task.zh: 根据目标回报或参考视频控制实际游玩得分水平。
task.en: Steer gameplay score to a return or video instruction.

observation.zh: ALE 画面与回报/视频提示。
observation.en: ALE images and return/video prompt.

action.zh: 18 类摇杆离散动作。
action.en: 18 discrete joystick actions.

metrics.zh: 各提示水平的回报 IQM 与 95% 区间。
metrics.en: Return IQM and 95% intervals by prompt level.

controls.zh: 35 游戏；归一化回报 −1/0/1；每指令 40 次；视频 128 帧。
controls.en: 35 games; normalized targets −1/0/1; 40 trials/instruction; 128-frame videos.

limits.zh: 衡量分数可控性，不强行对应九维；非跨未见游戏泛化。
limits.en: Measures score steering without forcing a nine-axis label; not unseen-game transfer.

label.zh: Craftax 生存与地下城进展

task.zh: 维持生存资源，制作工具、战斗并逐层推进地下城。
task.en: Maintain survival resources, craft tools, fight and progress through dungeon floors.

observation.zh: 局部符号地图、物品栏、生存资源和楼层状态。
observation.en: Local symbolic map, inventory, intrinsic resources and floor indicators.

action.zh: 移动、交互、制作、装备与上下楼等环境离散动作。
action.en: Discrete movement, interaction, crafting, equipment and floor traversal.

metrics.zh: 官方轨道以累计奖励占最大值 226 的百分比报告。
metrics.en: Official tracks report cumulative reward as a percentage of 226.

controls.zh: 分别记录 1M 与 1B 交互预算；固定版本、观测及重置设置。
controls.en: Keep 1M and 1B interaction tracks separate; fix version, observations and resets.

limits.zh: 综合奖励不分离单项能力；该节点也含 Classic 名称，但本单位仅适用于扩展 Craftax。
limits.en: Aggregate reward does not isolate abilities; this unit applies only to extended Craftax despite the combined index label.

basis.zh: 跨楼层推进依赖持续生存和多阶段装备升级。
basis.en: Cross-floor progression requires sustained survival and staged equipment upgrades.

basis.zh: 工具制作存在木材、石材、铁矿等先决依赖。
basis.en: Crafting has resource and tool prerequisites.

basis.zh: 必须发现资源和通往下一层的入口。

paragraphs.zh: TeamCraft 在 Minecraft 中设置蓝图建造、方块清除、耕作和冶炼任务。多个智能体结合语言与蓝图提示、各自视觉观测及物品信息，协同完成共同目标；项目提供程序生成的专家示范。
paragraphs.en: TeamCraft provides Minecraft tasks for blueprint building, clearing, farming and smelting. Agents combine language and blueprint prompts, individual visual observations and inventories to pursue shared goals, with procedural expert demonstrations.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究多模态动作策略、模仿学习与任务分工，以及协作策略对新目标、新场景和智能体数量变化的泛化。
paragraphs.en: It supports multimodal policies, imitation learning, task allocation and generalization to new goals, scenes and agent counts.

paragraphs.zh: 采用子目标成功率与完整任务成功率，分别刻画局部操作完成情况及团队目标达成情况。集中式与分布式模型提供不同信息组织方式下的比较。
paragraphs.en: Subgoal and full-task success rates characterize local execution and shared-objective completion. Centralized and decentralized models provide comparisons across information structures.

paragraphs.zh: 评测单元为指定任务、队伍规模与控制方式下的团队表现。视觉任务与文本简化设置对应不同观测条件。
paragraphs.en: The evaluation unit is team performance for a specified task, team size and control scheme. Visual tasks and simplified text settings use different observation conditions.

paragraphs.zh: Katakomba 为 NetHack 提供分角色配置的离线数据、加载工具与学习基线。策略从 AutoAscend 轨迹学习后，在 NetHack 环境中执行并接受评测。
paragraphs.en: Katakomba supplies character-specific NetHack datasets, loaders and offline-learning baselines. Policies learn from AutoAscend trajectories and are evaluated through subsequent NetHack interaction.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究离线强化学习、序列策略和数据利用，考察已有行为轨迹如何支持长序列决策与实际游戏表现。
paragraphs.en: It supports offline RL, sequential policies and data-use studies, examining how logged behavior supports long-sequence decisions and gameplay performance.

paragraphs.zh: 各角色分数按对应 AutoAscend 平均分归一化，并报告中位数、四分位均值及性能分布，以描述高变异回报下的总体表现。
paragraphs.en: Character scores are normalized to their corresponding AutoAscend mean, with medians, interquartile means and performance distributions summarizing highly variable returns.

paragraphs.zh: 训练采用固定离线轨迹，评测采用在线游戏得分。数据分布偏向早期游戏，角色配置、数据规模与运行预算决定具体实验范围。
paragraphs.en: Training uses fixed offline trajectories and evaluation measures online game scores. The data emphasize early gameplay; character configurations, dataset size and evaluation budgets define the experimental scope.

paragraphs.zh: Crafter 是采用像素视觉输入的开放式生存环境。智能体在随机生成的世界中寻找食物和材料、制作工具并保持生存，高级物品的获取依赖多阶段资源与制作链。
paragraphs.en: Crafter is an open-world survival environment with pixel observations and procedurally generated worlds. Agents gather food and materials, craft tools and survive through multistage resource and crafting chains.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究深度探索、技能组合和长期目标推进，并比较奖励驱动与内在目标驱动的学习方法。
paragraphs.en: It supports deep exploration, skill composition and sustained goal pursuit, including comparisons of reward-driven and intrinsically motivated learning.

paragraphs.zh: 统计各项成就的达成比例，并以几何平均汇总为 Crafter 分数。分成就表现呈现从基础生存到复杂制作的技能分布。
paragraphs.en: Achievement success rates are combined geometrically into the Crafter score. Per-achievement results expose the skill distribution from basic survival to advanced crafting.

paragraphs.zh: 评测围绕单一生存世界中的多项成就展开，环境版本、随机种子、奖励设置与交互预算构成实验条件。
paragraphs.en: Evaluation spans multiple achievements within one survival world. Environment version, seeds, reward settings and interaction budget define the experimental conditions.

task.zh: 控制电机和推进器，使绿色物体接触蓝色目标，避免红色碰撞。
task.en: Control motors/thrusters to bring green into blue while avoiding red.

observation.zh: 完整实体物理属性，包括位置、旋转、速度与连接关系。
observation.en: Fully observed entity properties, positions, rotations, velocities and connections.

action.zh: 每个电机的正转/反转/关闭及推进器开/关。
action.en: Per-motor forward/reverse/off and thruster on/off.

metrics.zh: 手工留出关卡成功率；成功 +1、失败碰撞 −1。
metrics.en: Solve rate on handmade holdouts; success +1 and forbidden collision −1.

controls.zh: 按 S/M/L 分组；训练 5B 交互、5 个种子；手工关卡不参与训练。
controls.en: Separate S/M/L sizes; 5B interactions and five seeds; handmade levels excluded from training.

limits.zh: 留出关卡仍处于训练分布支持内；不同关卡不自动拥有全部能力。
limits.en: Holdouts remain within training-distribution support; do not inherit every ability to each level.

basis.zh: 随机关卡训练后测试未见手工关卡。
basis.en: Tests unseen handmade levels after generated-level training.

basis.zh: 逐步驱动电机和推进器完成碰撞目标。
basis.en: Stepwise motor/thruster actuation achieves the contact goal.

evidence.title: Kinetix, Sections 3–5
evidence.excerpt: Multi-discrete motor/thruster control uses fully observed physical entities; handmade holdout solve rate measures transfer from generated training levels.

task.zh: 50款训练内、10款近分布外、5款远分布外游戏分别适应并在线评测
task.en: Adapt and evaluate on 50 ID, ten near-OOD and five far-OOD games

observation.zh: 84×84灰度图，堆叠4帧
observation.en: Four stacked 84×84 grayscale frames

action.zh: 游戏特定离散Atari动作
action.en: Game-specific discrete Atari actions

metrics.zh: 归一化游戏分数IQM与分层bootstrap；ID/近OOD用DQN，远OOD用2M步Rainbow参考
metrics.en: IQM normalized game score with stratified bootstrap; DQN reference for ID/near-OOD and 2M-step Rainbow for far-OOD

controls.zh: 3种子；骨干冻结，头重置；BC用5万示范帧100epochs，RL用5万交互
controls.en: Three seeds; frozen backbone with reset heads; BC uses 50K demonstration frames for 100 epochs, RL uses 50K interactions

limits.zh: 数据划分与适应预算是测量核心；仅登记平台集合协议，不能推断每款游戏都测记忆或规划
limits.en: Splits and adaptation budgets define the measurement; suite protocol does not assign memory/planning to every game

basis.zh: 在预训练外的新视觉、奖励和机制上比较迁移
basis.en: Compare transfer to unseen visuals, rewards and mechanics

task.en: Compare policies in the official two-player Ryu mirror scenario, recording round outcomes and a fixed-pool matchup matrix.

observation.zh: Gym Retro 图像接口；原始按键与转换动作空间可选，特殊招式宏需单独声明。原生基线为 RL。
observation.en: Gym Retro pixel interface, with raw-button or transformed actions; declare special-move macros. Native baselines use RL.

action.zh: Gym Retro 图像接口；原始按键与转换动作空间可选，特殊招式宏需单独声明。原生基线为 RL。
action.en: Gym Retro pixel interface, with raw-button or transformed actions; declare special-move macros. Native baselines use RL.

metrics.zh: 以回合胜率和固定池 Elo 比较；如运行统一 RL 攻击者，则另外报告其胜率，作为近似可利用性诊断。
metrics.en: Compare round win rate and fixed-pool Elo; a consistently trained RL exploiter may additionally provide an approximate exploitability diagnostic.

controls.zh: 固定 Genesis 版本、存档、Ryu 双方角色、动作宏、帧堆叠与动作保持；记录左右侧、对手池及奖励设置。
controls.en: Pin Genesis version, saves, Ryu characters, action macros, frame stacking and action duration; record sides, opponent pool and rewards.

limits.zh: 待游戏资源和 runner 校验；确定对局数、时序及预算。LLM/VLM 控制适配未验证；不把 Elo 当作绝对能力分。
limits.en: Pending game assets, runner validation, match counts, timing and budgets. LLM/VLM adapters are unverified; Elo is not an absolute capability score.

task.zh: 从画面判断情况并操作游戏，推进预设关卡检查点。
task.en: Operate from visual observations and advance predefined level checkpoints.

observation.zh: 原始屏幕帧与目标/操作说明；无 RAM、解析状态或中间奖励。
observation.en: Raw frames and objective/control instructions; no RAM, parsed state or intermediate rewards.

action.zh: 语言接口输出按键、按键序列及持续时间。

metrics.zh: 到达检查点占该游戏全部检查点的比例。
metrics.en: Fraction of the game's predefined checkpoints reached.

controls.zh: 固定起点、游戏时限和重启规则；区分持续运行与推理时暂停的 Lite。
controls.en: Fix start, time cap and restart rules; distinguish real-time running from paused-inference Lite.

limits.zh: Doom II 的具体时限/检查点清单需随发布配置锁定；Lite 不测相同实时延迟约束。
limits.en: Pin Doom II's exact cap/checkpoint list to the release; Lite removes real-time inference pressure.

basis.zh: 动作持续时间、瞄准与移动直接影响关卡推进。
basis.en: Action timing, aiming and movement directly affect level progression.

label.en: Run and Gun cross-domain continual learning

task.zh: 依次学习不同外观/动态的射击场景，持续保持早期任务表现。
task.en: Learn successive shooting variants while retaining earlier-task performance.

observation.zh: 第一人称游戏像素。
observation.en: Egocentric game pixels.

action.zh: 移动、转向和攻击等场景控制动作。
action.en: Scenario movement, turning and attack controls.

metrics.zh: 击杀相关任务表现、平均表现、遗忘与前向迁移。
metrics.en: Kill-based task performance, average performance, forgetting and forward transfer.

controls.zh: 固定 8 任务跨域顺序；每回合最多 2,500 步；顺序训练时不可访问先前任务。
controls.en: Fix the eight-task cross-domain order; 2,500-step episodes; no previous-task access during sequential training.

limits.zh: 保持任务边界、训练预算和 SAC 参照一致；非零样本跨游戏测试。
limits.en: Match task boundaries, training budgets and SAC reference; not zero-shot cross-game testing.

basis.zh: 显式改变纹理、敌人、视角高度及障碍，并衡量迁移。
basis.en: Explicit appearance/dynamics changes are evaluated through transfer.

basis.zh: 场景要求导航并开火消灭敌人。
basis.en: Navigation and firing are required to eliminate enemies.

observation.zh: 160×120 RGB；原实验下采样为 84×84 灰度。
observation.en: 160×120 RGB, downsampled to 84×84 grayscale in reported experiments.

action.zh: 每场景固定的受限多离散控制动作。
action.en: Restricted multi-discrete controls fixed within each scenario.

metrics.zh: 击杀数或存活帧数；对五次运行取均值。

limits.zh: 障碍和敌人类型同时改变动力学，不能视为纯视觉不变性测试。
limits.en: Obstacles and enemy types also alter dynamics; this is not pure visual invariance.

basis.zh: 测试明确排除训练中的高修改等级。
basis.en: Higher modification levels are explicitly held out.

basis.zh: 击杀/存活指标依赖实时射击或躲避控制。
basis.en: Kill/survival metrics depend on shooting or evasion control.

paragraphs.zh: Procgen 包含16个程序生成的视觉游戏，采用共同的像素观测与离散动作接口。CoinRun 要求越障取币，Heist 要求找钥匙开锁；各游戏内部的地图与物体配置也持续变化。
paragraphs.en: Procgen contains sixteen procedurally generated visual games with shared pixel observations and discrete actions. CoinRun involves reaching a coin past obstacles and Heist uses keys and locks; layouts and objects vary within games.

paragraphs.zh: 用于比较强化学习的样本效率与未见关卡泛化。限制训练关卡集合并设置独立测试关卡，可以研究表征学习、过拟合和训练分布多样性的作用。
paragraphs.en: It supports sample-efficiency and held-out-level generalization studies. Restricted training levels and independent test levels enable analysis of representations, overfitting and training-distribution diversity.

paragraphs.zh: 按游戏统计训练与测试回报，并依据所用协议归一化和汇总。分游戏结果描述任务差异，训练—测试回报差刻画泛化表现。
paragraphs.en: Training and test returns are reported per game and normalized and aggregated under the selected protocol. Per-game outcomes characterize task differences, while train–test gaps characterize generalization.

paragraphs.zh: 原始评测套件覆盖16个环境，后续竞赛采用独立协议。关卡划分、难度、环境版本与交互预算确定相应的实验范围。
paragraphs.en: The original suite covers sixteen environments; subsequent competitions use separate protocols. Level splits, difficulty, versions and interaction budgets define each experimental scope.

body.zh: 按游戏统计训练与测试回报，并依据所用协议归一化和汇总。分游戏结果描述任务差异，训练—测试回报差刻画泛化表现。
body.en: Training and test returns are reported per game and normalized and aggregated under the selected protocol. Per-game outcomes characterize task differences, while train–test gaps characterize generalization.

body.zh: 原始评测套件覆盖16个环境，后续竞赛采用独立协议。关卡划分、难度、环境版本与交互预算确定相应的实验范围。
body.en: The original suite covers sixteen environments; subsequent competitions use separate protocols. Level splits, difficulty, versions and interaction budgets define each experimental scope.

profile.summary: Test whether policies learn transferable skills rather than memorize fixed levels.
profile.zh: 程序生成、街机游戏、强化学习、样本效率与泛化。
profile.observation: RGB pixels.
profile.action: Discrete game actions.
profile.protocol: Sixteen procedurally generated environments; train/test level selection is essential for interpreting generalization.
profile.limit: Performance depends on level distribution, difficulty and training budget. Keep these conditions attached to reported results.
profile.why: A foundational reference for generalization across unseen game levels.
profile.note: Environment count and generalization focus are documented in the official repository.

research.scope: 16 个程序生成环境；显式定义训练/测试关卡
research.fit: 研究固定训练预算下对未见关卡的适应。
research.metrics: 分开报告训练与测试回报；附训练样本量。
research.controls: 关卡种子范围、训练关卡数、难度、游戏、训练预算。
research.setup: 原生 RL 像素接口；需要固定运行库版本，LLM 适配未核验。

evidence.mechanism: 程序生成关卡用于评估可泛化的 RL 技能。
evidence.scope: 需显式分离训练关卡和测试关卡。

evidence.mechanism: 智能体从 RGB 图像选择离散按键动作。
evidence.scope: 视觉控制接口；总回报混合感知与决策。

profile.sourceScope: Bibliographic metadata from the existing collection; official repositories checked for this demo. Thematic tags are editorial coverage labels, not isolated capability scores.

task.zh: 从 Procgen 选择 CoinRun；在明确隔离的关卡范围上评测到达金币的能力。
task.en: Select CoinRun from Procgen; evaluate reaching the coin on explicitly held-out level ranges.

observation.zh: 原生 64×64 RGB 观测与离散动作；LLM 适配需另行定义动作重复和帧采样。
observation.en: Native 64×64 RGB observations and discrete actions; LLM adaptation requires explicit action repeat and frame sampling.

action.zh: 原生 64×64 RGB 观测与离散动作；LLM 适配需另行定义动作重复和帧采样。
action.en: Native 64×64 RGB observations and discrete actions; LLM adaptation requires explicit action repeat and frame sampling.

metrics.zh: 环境回报与关卡完成情况；分别报告训练范围和未见范围的表现及差距。
metrics.en: Environment return and level completion; report training-range and held-out performance plus the gap.

controls.zh: 固定 distribution_mode、关卡范围、训练/适应预算与评测样本；零样本 LLM 和训练后 RL 分轨比较。
controls.en: Fix distribution_mode, level ranges, training/adaptation budget and evaluation sample. Separate zero-shot LLM and trained RL tracks.

limits.zh: 需锁定训练/适应/测试划分与环境版本，并实现像素控制适配。
limits.en: Pin training/adaptation/test splits and the environment version; implement the visual-control adapter.

basis.zh: 程序生成关卡提供可复现的分布划分，适合检查是否只记住训练布局。仅更换种子不自动构成有效泛化实验。
basis.en: Procedural levels support reproducible splits for testing layout memorization. A seed change alone does not establish a valid generalization experiment.

basis.zh: 程序生成关卡提供可复现的分布划分，适合检查是否只记住训练布局。仅更换种子不自动构成有效泛化实验。
basis.en: Procedural levels support reproducible splits for testing layout memorization. A seed change alone does not establish a valid generalization experiment.

task.zh: 从 Procgen 选择 Dodgeball；固定难度与关卡范围，观察移动、朝向和投掷行为。
task.en: Select Dodgeball from Procgen; fix difficulty and level ranges, and inspect movement, orientation and throwing.

observation.zh: 原生 RGB 观测与离散动作；动作重复、帧采样和延迟必须进入协议。
observation.en: Native RGB observations and discrete actions; action repeat, frame sampling and latency belong in the protocol.

action.zh: 原生 RGB 观测与离散动作；动作重复、帧采样和延迟必须进入协议。
action.en: Native RGB observations and discrete actions; action repeat, frame sampling and latency belong in the protocol.

metrics.zh: 任务指标：回报与关卡完成情况。Arena 建议补充：动作频率、决策延迟和失败轨迹分类。
metrics.en: Task measures: return and level completion. Proposed additions: action frequency, decision latency and failure-trace categories.

controls.zh: 固定关卡分布、难度、观测频率、动作粒度和训练预算；暂停式与实时控制不可直接排名。
controls.en: Fix level distribution, difficulty, observation rate, action granularity and training budget. Paused and real-time control are not directly rankable.

limits.zh: 需实现控制适配并验证时间推进方式；这一个游戏不能代表全部视觉运动技能。
limits.en: Implement the control adapter and validate time advancement. One game cannot represent all visuomotor skills.

basis.zh: 空间布局和面向方向直接影响行动效果，补充文本策略任务中较弱的感知与控制要求。
basis.en: Spatial layout and facing direction affect action outcomes, complementing the lighter control demands of text strategy tasks.

limits.zh: 模型选择是否使用在线交互必须分开；不把机器人任务混入游戏能力图
limits.en: Online interaction during model selection must be distinguished; robotics tasks are excluded

basis.zh: 离线训练的策略仍通过真实游戏回合获得分数
basis.en: Offline-trained policies obtain scores through live gameplay

evidence.title: RL Unplugged: A Suite of Benchmarks for Offline Reinforcement Learning

taskReview.noteZh: 全文3.3、4.3与表3核验46款而非ALE全部57款，9/37策略选择划分和最佳数据策略归一化；只登记Atari部分。 本轮归属复核：依据官方配置的实际数组关联46款：9款在线选参、37款离线选择评测。配置中的旧注释写45/36，与数组数量不符，因此以数组和论文为准。
taskReview.noteEn: Sections 3.3/4.3 and table 3 verify 46 games rather than all 57 ALE titles, the 9/37 selection split and best-data-policy normalization; Atari only. Routing review: Route forty-six explicit configuration entries: nine tuning and thirty-seven evaluation games. Stale 45/36 comments disagree with the executable lists and paper.

evidence.excerpt: Confirms domain-specific offline-RL protocols; Atari must be separated from non-game control

paragraphs.zh: CivRealm 基于 Freeciv-web 提供文明经营与竞争环境，支持张量 RL 和语言智能体接口。完整对局涉及探索、城市与单位发展、科技和外交，专项小游戏在相同规则下聚焦局部决策。
paragraphs.en: CivRealm provides civilization management and competition in Freeciv-web, supporting tensor-RL and language-agent interfaces. Full games involve exploration, cities, units, technology and diplomacy; minigames target particular decisions under the same rules.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究长期战略、资源取舍与层次化决策。完整对局考察多目标协调，建城选址等小游戏则支持对特定决策环节的分析。
paragraphs.en: It supports long-term strategy, resource trade-offs and hierarchical decisions. Full games examine coordination across objectives, while minigames such as city-site selection support analysis of specific decision components.

paragraphs.zh: 完整游戏统计人口、城市、科技、单位、探索范围与综合得分；专项小游戏采用各自的目标和指标，例如建城任务中的资源得分。
paragraphs.en: Full-game measures include population, cities, technologies, units, exploration and aggregate score. Minigames use task-specific objectives and metrics, such as resource scores for city placement.

paragraphs.zh: 完整对局与专项小游戏构成两个评测层级。地图、对手、初始局面、回合预算，以及语言或张量观测接口定义各层级的实验设置。

profile.summary: Cooperative multi-agent learning under partial observability and randomized combat scenarios.
profile.zh: 多智能体协作、部分可观测，星际争霸微操评测。
profile.observation: Local unit observations; state access depends on training setup.
profile.action: Decentralized movement and combat actions for controlled units.
profile.protocol: Cooperative StarCraft II micromanagement scenarios, with scenario variation and team performance evaluation.
profile.limit: This evaluates micromanagement rather than full-game macro strategy. An LLM adaptation is not implied by the native RL interface.
profile.why: A focused counterpart to broad game suites when coordination is the research question.
profile.note: Scope and native MARL use are documented in the official README. Not independently rerun.

Data use is restricted to training-task demonstrations; the MiniArcade aggregate does not imply demonstrations for additional held-out tasks.

bibliography.authors: Zelai Xu; Ruize Zhang; Chao Yu; Huining Yuan; Xiangmin Yi; Shilong Ji; Chuqi Wang; Wenhao Tang; Feng Gao; Wenbo Ding; Xinlei Chen; Yu Wang

basis.zh: 摘要及实验训练并比较单体 RL、MARL 与层级策略，并报告胜率。
basis.en: The abstract and experiments train and compare single-agent RL, MARL and hierarchical policies with win-rate evaluation.

agentReview.noteZh: 多无人机动作控制不是视觉语言控制；原文明确没有专家演示，未据此加入 IL。
agentReview.noteEn: Multi-drone motion control is not vision-language control; the paper states expert demonstrations are unavailable, so IL is not inferred.

evidence.title: VolleyBots: A Testbed for Multi-Drone Volleyball Game Combining Motion Control and Strategic Play
evidence.locator: Abstract; baseline algorithms and multi-drone experiments
evidence.summary: VolleyBots evaluates RL/MARL baselines and a trained hierarchical volleyball policy.

profile.summary: VolleyBots: A Testbed for Multi-Drone Volleyball Game Combining Motion Control and Strategic Play

task.zh: 二传先触球传给攻击者，再向下扣入目标区
task.en: Setter passes to attacker, who spikes downward into the target region

observation.zh: 40维自身状态、锚点相对位置、身份、触球轮次、球与队友相对状态
observation.en: 40-dimensional own/anchor state, identity, hit count, ball and teammate-relative state

action.zh: 连续推力/机体角速度或分旋翼推力，控制配置分开
action.en: Continuous collective thrust/body rates or per-rotor thrust, with configurations separate

metrics.zh: (二传触球+攻击者触球+向下扣球+落入目标区)/4；五种子平均
metrics.en: Mean of four indicators: setter hit, attacker hit, downward spike and target landing; five-seed aggregate

controls.zh: 800步上限；给定锚点附近随机初始化；无人机限0.5m球域；有/无奖励塑形对照
controls.en: 800-step cap; randomized starts near specified anchors; drones restricted to0.5m anchor spheres; shaping/no-shaping comparisons

limits.zh: 论文称成功率但实际是四项平均，不能解释为全部条件同时成功率；模拟无人机而非电子游戏原作
limits.en: Called success rate in the paper but defined as an average of four indicators, not joint success probability; simulated drones, not a commercial game

basis.zh: 二传与扣球角色必须按序合作
basis.en: Setter and attacker roles must cooperate sequentially

label.zh: 足球学院：三打一与守门员

task.zh: 仅在三名受控球员分别由可行动主体控制时，将传跑配合归为协作；单控制器模式应改列策略/控制。
task.en: Count coordination only when three controllable players are assigned distinct acting policies; single-controller mode belongs under strategy/control.

observation.zh: create_environment，建议 raw 观测；number_of_left_players_agent_controls=3，右侧0；每次传入三个动作，默认动作集19项。
observation.en: create_environment with raw observations, three controlled left players and zero right players; supply three actions from the default 19-action set.

action.zh: create_environment，建议 raw 观测；number_of_left_players_agent_controls=3，右侧0；每次传入三个动作，默认动作集19项。
action.en: create_environment with raw observations, three controlled left players and zero right players; supply three actions from the default 19-action set.

metrics.zh: scoring 回报为比分差的变化；原生暴露 score 与 info.score_reward。 固定 scoring-only 时统计进球成功率、球权丢失与出界终止次数；不得把传球次数单独当作协作水平。
metrics.en: Scoring reward is the change in score difference; native fields include score and info.score_reward. Under scoring-only evaluation report scoring success, possession-loss and out-of-play endings; pass count alone is not coordination quality.

controls.zh: 官方场景：game_duration=400，随机环境，关闭越位；进球、出界或球权改变即终止。 固定三主体分配、共享信息/通信规则、对手、种子、动作集及物理步频；区分 scoring 与 checkpoints 塑形。
controls.en: Official scenario uses game_duration=400, stochastic dynamics, offsides disabled, and termination on score, out-of-play or possession change. Fix policy-to-player assignment, shared information/communication, opponents, seeds, action set and physics step frequency; distinguish scoring from checkpoint shaping.

limits.zh: 短攻门场景，不代表完整11人足球比赛或长期战略。原生多球员接口需要调度层分派到独立 Agent；当前任务未接入运行，LLM/VLM 支持未核验。 待锁定资源与版本、逐任务预算、种子清单和适配器，并完成运行验证。
limits.en: A short attacking scenario, not full 11-a-side football or long-term strategy. The multi-player interface needs a dispatcher for independent agents; no runner is connected and LLM/VLM support is unverified. Pin assets and versions, per-task budgets, seed lists and adapters; complete runtime validation.

profile.summary: Code World Models for General Game Playing

task.zh: 用合成代码世界模型进行 MCTS 搜索，并在井字棋和四子棋中完成对局。
task.en: Use a synthesized code world model for MCTS and play complete Tic-Tac-Toe and Connect Four matches.

observation.zh: 规则、轨迹用于模型合成；对局阶段读取当前棋盘状态及可用动作。
observation.en: Rules and trajectories support model synthesis; gameplay uses the current board state and available actions.

action.zh: 搜索后提交一个棋盘落子动作。
action.en: Submit one board-placement move selected by search.

metrics.zh: 按先后手报告胜/和/负，单列无效动作或超时导致的弃权。
metrics.en: Win/draw/loss by seat, separating forfeits from invalid actions or timeouts.

controls.zh: 模型合成重复五次并筛除坏样本；每场随机选择一个 CWM；每对手/座位的结果基于 100 场。
controls.en: Synthesis is repeated five times with bad samples rejected; a CWM is randomly selected per match; results use 100 matches per opponent/seat.

limits.zh: 只核验两种标准棋盘任务；不把代码状态转移准确率或其他自定义游戏结果并入；搜索预算须沿用原文。
limits.en: Only two standard board tasks are included; transition-prediction accuracy and custom-game results are excluded; search budgets must follow the paper.

basis.zh: 动作由候选未来状态的显式 MCTS 搜索决定。
basis.en: Moves are selected through explicit MCTS over candidate future states.

evidence.title: Code World Models for General Game Playing

task.zh: 两位玩家在看不到自身牌的条件下，通过提示、出牌和弃牌共同完成颜色牌堆。
task.en: Two players use hints, plays and discards to build shared color stacks while unable to see their own cards.

observation.zh: 队友手牌、自己的已揭示信息、牌堆、弃牌、余牌、生命及信息令牌；不含自己未揭示的牌面。
observation.en: Partner cards, revealed own-card information, stacks, discards, remaining deck, life and information tokens; no unrevealed own cards.

action.zh: 选择合法 Play、Discard、Reveal color 或 Reveal rank，并按要求格式输出。
action.en: Choose legal Play, Discard, Reveal color or Reveal rank actions in the required format.

metrics.zh: 标准自博弈共享得分及归一化回报；Mini Hanabi 满分 4，耗尽生命按该协议计 0。
metrics.en: Shared self-play score and normalized return; Mini Hanabi maximum is four, and exhausting lives yields zero under its protocol.

controls.zh: 论文战略能力评测为 1,000 局；Mini Hanabi 用于训练，Simple Hanabi 为保留游戏；分别保留各自牌数/令牌配置。
controls.en: Strategic evaluation uses 1,000 games; Mini Hanabi is trained and Simple Hanabi held out; their card/token configurations remain separate.

limits.zh: 仅花火变体协议，不把数学/QA 系统迁移计为游戏任务；共享单位不将两个变体原始分数直接混合。
limits.en: Only the Hanabi-variant protocol is included; math/QA transfer is excluded, and raw scores of the two variants are not pooled.

basis.zh: 共同得分依赖对伙伴提示的解释和有限信息令牌分配。
basis.en: Shared score depends on interpreting partner hints and allocating limited information tokens.

profile.summary: Mastering the Game of Stratego with Model-Free Multiagent Reinforcement Learning

task.zh: 在标准 Stratego 中部署棋子并进行隐藏棋子身份的完整对局。
task.en: Deploy pieces and play complete Stratego games with hidden piece identities.

observation.zh: 自身棋子、公开棋面和对敌方棋子身份的可见信息；编码包含最近 40 步历史。
observation.en: Own pieces, public board and available enemy-identity information; encoding includes the latest 40 moves.

action.zh: 部署阶段选择位置；对局阶段选择合法移动的起点和终点。
action.en: Select deployment positions, then legal move origins and destinations during play.

metrics.zh: 50 场人类排位赛胜率及当时的 Kleier 评分。
metrics.en: Win rate over 50 ranked human matches and the contemporaneous Kleier rating.

controls.zh: 2022 年 4 月约两周的 50 场公开排位对局，报告 42 胜；部署及对局规则沿用论文。
controls.en: Fifty public ranked matches over about two weeks in April 2022, reporting 42 wins; deployment/gameplay rules follow the paper.

limits.zh: 历史在线对手池，非固定当代排行榜；历史输入不等于独立记忆能力消融，未单独标记记忆轴。
limits.en: Historical online opponent pool, not a current fixed leaderboard; history inputs do not isolate memory ability, so no separate memory tag is assigned.

basis.zh: 隐藏棋子身份下的部署、侦察和进攻构成对抗性取舍。
basis.en: Deployment, probing and attack under hidden piece identities require adversarial tradeoffs.

evidence.excerpt: The paper describes deployment/gameplay actions, partial-information observations with move history, and 50 ranked human matches in April 2022.

task.zh: 一名地主对两名农民，选择出牌组合或过牌，完成每副牌的对抗。
task.en: Play one landlord against two peasants, choosing card combinations or pass to finish each deal.

observation.zh: 自身手牌、牌数及出牌历史等位置可见特征；历史经序列编码。
observation.en: Role-visible features including own cards, card counts and play history, with sequence encoding of history.

action.zh: 对所有合法出牌组合或 pass 打分并选择。
action.en: Score and select a legal card combination or pass.

metrics.zh: 胜率 WP 和平均分差 ADP；基础分 1，炸弹加倍。
metrics.en: Winning percentage (WP) and average difference in points (ADP); base score one, doubled by bombs.

controls.zh: 10,000 副随机牌；各位置单独比较，再汇总，地主与农民角色不混淆。
controls.en: 10,000 random deals; compare each seat separately before aggregation, preserving landlord/peasant roles.

limits.zh: 此协议不包含单独的叫牌评测；农民有团队目标但没有自然语言沟通。
limits.en: This protocol excludes the separate bidding evaluation; peasants share a team objective without natural-language communication.

basis.zh: 根据手牌、出牌历史和对手剩余牌选择牌型。
basis.en: Card choices depend on own hand, play history and opponents’ remaining cards.

basis.zh: 仅农民角色共享胜负，需要配合另一名农民阻止地主先出完。
basis.en: Only the peasant roles share outcomes and coordinate to stop the landlord finishing first.

profile.summary: Cooperate with limited communication when you cannot see your own cards.
profile.zh: 花火、合作卡牌、不完全信息、有限通信与伙伴推理。
profile.observation: Player-relative observations, public information and hints.
profile.action: Play, discard or give a legal hint.
profile.protocol: The challenge and learning environment support research on cooperative play under hidden information; specify the partner protocol.
profile.limit: Self-play and play with unfamiliar partners answer different questions. A high self-play score is not evidence of robust cross-play.
profile.why: Separates cooperative decision making from simple access to shared information.
profile.note: The official learning environment exposes an RL interface. Other agent adaptations are not audited in this demo.

research.scope: Hanabi 合作卡牌；先明确 self-play / cross-play
research.fit: 研究有限提示下的伙伴推理与协作约定。

research.controls: 玩家数、提示规则、伙伴来源、训练方式与牌局种子。
research.setup: 原生 RL 环境；可构建其他智能体，现成 LLM 适配未核验。

evidence.scope: 依赖伙伴协议；得分不能独立验证社会推理。

evidence.scope: 合作博弈决策；不是对抗式战略评估。

profile.summary: A common research interface for learning and evaluating agents in card games.
profile.zh: 卡牌、扑克、麻将、斗地主、不完全信息博弈。
profile.observation: Game-specific encoded observations and legal actions.
profile.action: Legal discrete card-game actions.
profile.protocol: A platform with multiple games and baseline agents. Evaluation requires an explicit game and opponent configuration.
profile.limit: A shared interface does not define a single universal evaluation protocol. This entry is classified as a research platform.
profile.why: Useful infrastructure for comparing decisions under hidden information.
profile.note: Platform scope and supported games are documented by the official repository.

research.scope: 单独选择卡牌游戏与对手，例如 Leduc Hold’em
research.fit: 构建隐含信息下的决策与对手比较实验。
research.metrics: 按游戏与对手定义收益；先明确评估协议。
research.controls: 游戏规则、对手集合、座位、随机种子与训练预算。
research.setup: 研究平台与基线；统一接口没有指定唯一的 benchmark 协议。

evidence.mechanism: 多种卡牌环境支持规则和信息约束下的决策。
evidence.scope: 游戏与对手协议必须另行指定。

profile.sourceScope: Bibliographic metadata from the existing collection; official repositories checked for this demo. Thematic tags are editorial coverage labels, not isolated capability scores.

task.zh: 两轮下注中根据私牌、公牌和筹码争取净收益。
task.en: Seek net payoff over two betting rounds with private and public cards.

observation.zh: 私牌、公牌及双方筹码的 36 维编码；不见对手私牌。
observation.en: 36-element encoding of own/public card and both chip counts; opponent card hidden.

action.zh: 合法的跟注、加注、弃牌、过牌。
action.en: Legal call, raise, fold and check.

metrics.zh: 每局以大盲注为单位的净收益。
metrics.en: Net payoff in big blinds per hand.

controls.zh: 两人、六张牌、两轮、每轮最多两次下注；固定对手、随机种子和评估局数。
controls.en: Two players, six cards, two rounds, two-bet cap; fix opponents, seeds and hand count.

limits.zh: 这是平台任务，不是统一对手下的现成排名；不能推断社交语言能力。
limits.en: A platform task, not a fixed-opponent ranking or language-social test.

basis.zh: 下注需权衡未知对手手牌与潜在损失。
basis.en: Betting balances unknown opponent cards against potential losses.

task.zh: 在Chameleon与Undercover中给线索、推断身份和投票。
task.en: Give clues, infer roles, and vote in Chameleon and Undercover.

observation.zh: 角色限定秘密词和公开线索/讨论。
observation.en: Role-filtered secret words and public clues/discussion.

action.zh: 线索文本、身份判断、投票及秘密词猜测。
action.en: Clues, role deductions, votes, and secret-word guesses.

metrics.zh: 正确投票率、身份推断正确率、成功欺骗率和角色胜率。
metrics.en: Correct-vote rate, deduction accuracy, deception success, and role win rate.

controls.zh: 固定场景和角色安排；分角色报告；按论文表3协议。
controls.en: Fixed scenarios/role assignments; role-specific reporting under Table 3.

limits.zh: 只覆盖两个隐藏身份游戏，不将这组诊断传播至其他三游戏。
limits.en: Only the two hidden-role games; these diagnostics do not apply to the other three.

basis.zh: 依据不对称信息推断他人身份并影响他人判断。
basis.en: Infer identities from asymmetric information and influence others’ judgments.

evidence.title: MAgIC: A Benchmark for Multi-Agent Interaction in Competitive and Cooperative Scenarios
evidence.excerpt: Give clues, infer roles, and vote in Chameleon and Undercover. Metrics: Correct-vote rate, deduction accuracy, deception success, and role win rate.

task.zh: 向公共池贡献点数并争取最高最终收益。
task.en: Contribute points to a public pool and maximize final payoff.

observation.zh: 规则、倍增系数与交互历史。
observation.en: Rules, multiplier and interaction history.

action.zh: 每轮输出贡献点数。
action.en: Submit a point contribution each round.

metrics.zh: 最高分胜率、个人收益与公共池返还。
metrics.en: Highest-score win rate, individual payoff and communal payback.

controls.zh: 3 人、5 轮；7 倍增设置 × 3 席位；其余玩家固定 GPT-4。
controls.en: Three players, five rounds; seven multipliers × three seats; other players fixed to GPT-4.

limits.zh: 合作与个人最高分目标可能冲突；并非独立公平性测量。
limits.en: Cooperation can conflict with the individual winning objective; not an independent fairness measurement.

basis.zh: 贡献成本、共同返还与相对收益存在明确取舍。
basis.en: Contributions trade personal cost against communal return and relative payoff.

evidence.title: MAgIC: A Benchmark for Multi-Agent Interaction in Competitive and Cooperative Scenarios
evidence.excerpt: Appendix A specifies 21 public-goods settings: three players, five rounds, seven multipliers and rotated test seats. Individual winning rate is distinct from communal welfare.

basis.zh: 附录A.1明确三名玩家在5轮中选择合作或背叛，累计分数决定胜负；改变收益设置并轮换待测模型角色。模型行动推进重复博弈，不是固定问答题。
basis.en: Appendix A.1 defines three players choosing cooperation or defection over five rounds, with cumulative payoffs and role-swapped evaluation across payoff settings. Model actions advance a repeated game rather than answer fixed questions.

evidence.title: MAgIC — Appendix A.1–A.2 and Table 2
evidence.excerpt: Prisoner’s Dilemma runs five action rounds; Cost Sharing runs negotiated proposals and agreement checks, with game-specific outcomes and metrics.

paragraphs.zh: Bench-MFG 提供离散时间、离散状态的平稳平均场博弈，涵盖不同交互性质的问题类别及随机 MF-Garnet 实例。求解目标是个体策略与群体分布相容的均衡。
paragraphs.en: Bench-MFG provides discrete-time, discrete-state stationary mean-field games, including contrasting interaction classes and random MF-Garnet instances. Solvers seek equilibria with compatible individual policies and population distributions.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究均衡求解、算法收敛及对问题结构变化的鲁棒性，可在具有不同交互性质的实例间比较学习算法与数值求解器。
paragraphs.en: It supports equilibrium computation, convergence analysis and robustness studies, comparing learning algorithms and numerical solvers across interaction structures.

paragraphs.zh: 主要指标为可利用度，即固定群体分布下个体转向最佳回应所获得的收益增量。收敛曲线与多实例统计刻画求解效率、稳定性和失效模式。
paragraphs.en: Exploitability measures the gain from switching to a best response against a fixed population distribution. Convergence curves and instance-wise statistics characterize efficiency, stability and failure modes.

paragraphs.zh: 评测对象为数学博弈中的策略与分布求解，实验条件包括博弈类别、随机实例、算法配置及求解预算。
paragraphs.en: Evaluation concerns policy and distribution solvers for mathematical games, parameterized by game class, random instances, algorithm configuration and solver budget.

profile.summary: Social Gym and SPaRTan: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Social Reasoning via Multi-Agent Game Tournaments

task.zh: 扮演村民阵营或狼人阵营，通过发言、投票与角色行动取得阵营胜利。
task.en: Play a village or wolf role through speech, voting and role actions to achieve a team win.

observation.zh: 公开消息与按角色授权的私有信息。
observation.en: Public messages and role-authorized private information.

action.zh: 按状态提供 JSON 动作类型及参数：发言、投票、夜间击杀或角色技能。
action.en: State-dependent JSON action types and arguments for speech, voting, night kills and role abilities.

metrics.zh: 阵营胜负、按角色统计胜率；锦标赛结果经 Bradley–Terry MLE 得到 Elo。
metrics.en: Team outcomes and role-conditioned win rates; tournament outcomes feed Bradley–Terry MLE Elo.

controls.zh: 有限状态调度；40 轮上限；村民消灭狼人获胜，狼人达到人数平衡获胜。
controls.en: Finite-state scheduling, forty-turn cap, village victory on eliminating wolves and wolf victory at parity.

limits.zh: 这里只接入狼人杀，不把协议或能力复制给其余 20 个游戏；角色、配对与调度必须一致，Elo 依赖对手池。
limits.en: Only Werewolves is included, without propagating its protocol to the other twenty games. Match roles and scheduling; Elo depends on the opponent pool.

basis.zh: 隐藏角色与发言/投票策略由角色条件胜率评估。
basis.en: Hidden-role speech and voting decisions are evaluated with role-conditioned win rates.

evidence.title: Social Gym and SPaRTan, Appendix D and tournament evaluation
evidence.excerpt: Werewolves uses role-aware information and legal actions in a finite-state schedule with a forty-turn limit. Village wins by eliminating wolves; wolves win at parity. Tournament outcomes support role-conditioned win rates.

basis.zh: §3.2与附录E列明21种博弈；附录D共用FSM交互循环，动作处理器更新内部状态并由规则裁判终局计分。17种竞争博弈用胜负结果拟合Elo，4种合作博弈报告胜率。用途确认不把狼人杀的能力细项复制到其余20游戏。
basis.en: Section 3.2 and Appendix E name 21 games; Appendix D documents an FSM loop, state-changing action handlers and rule-based end evaluators. Competitive games use outcome-based Elo and four cooperative games use win rates. This confirms interactive use without copying Werewolves capability units to other games.

taskReview.noteEn: This pass includes a bounded task with explicit observations, actions and metrics; remaining configuration gaps are recorded in limits. Literature reviewed, not reproduced and not an Arena runnable claim.

evidence.title: Social Gym and SPaRTan: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Social Reasoning via Multi-Agent Game Tournaments
evidence.excerpt: Social Gym provides 21 social games with verifiable outcomes; SPaRTan is a training method, not an extra task.

evidence.title: Social Gym and SPaRTan: Benchmarking and Improving LLM Social Reasoning via Multi-Agent Game Tournaments
evidence.excerpt: Section 5 uses typically thirty games per condition (approximately ±18 percentage-point intervals), with playbooks injected separately by role. Cross-game transfer concerns prompting strategies; per-game action/termination configurations for all 21 games remain incomplete.

evidence.title: Social Gym and SPaRTan, Appendix D and tournament evaluation
evidence.excerpt: Werewolves uses role-aware information and legal actions in a finite-state schedule with a forty-turn limit. Village wins by eliminating wolves; wolves win at parity. Tournament outcomes support role-conditioned win rates.

followup.noteZh: 正文 §5 明确反思实验每条件通常仅 30 局、约 ±18 个百分点置信区间，且按少数/多数角色分别注入 playbook。跨游戏迁移是提示策略迁移，不是同一操控策略的零样本通用性；21 游戏逐一动作与终止配置仍需核对。
followup.noteEn: Section 5 uses typically thirty games per condition (approximately ±18 percentage-point intervals), with playbooks injected separately by role. Cross-game transfer concerns prompting strategies; per-game action/termination configurations for all 21 games remain incomplete.

task.zh: 在合法国际象棋对局中争取胜利。
task.en: Win legal chess games.

observation.zh: FEN 与完整 PGN 历史，不提供合法着法列表。
observation.en: FEN and full PGN history without legal-move hints.

action.zh: 输出 SAN 着法。
action.en: Output a SAN move.

metrics.zh: Bradley–Terry Elo、bootstrap 区间和非法着法重试频率。
metrics.en: Bradley–Terry Elo, bootstrap intervals and illegal-move retry frequency.

controls.zh: 每对模型 40 局，白黑各 20；非法动作最多 3 次重试。
controls.en: Forty games per model pair, twenty per color; at most three invalid-move retries.

limits.zh: 内部 Elo 依赖参赛池；四次失败判负会混入格式可靠性。
limits.en: Internal Elo depends on the pool; four failures forfeit and conflate formatting reliability.

basis.zh: 对抗性着法选择以终局胜负评价。
basis.en: Adversarial move selection is evaluated by terminal outcomes.

evidence.title: Game Arena: Strategic LLM Evaluation in Competitive Environments
evidence.excerpt: Section 2 and Appendix B distinguish Chess/Poker/Werewolf inputs, invalid-action handling and primary metrics. Added three independent protocols without inventing a cross-game total score.

task.zh: 在不完全信息下注中最大化筹码期望收益。
task.en: Maximize expected chip return through imperfect-information betting.

observation.zh: 位置、筹码、私牌、公牌、下注记录及本段全部手牌历史。
observation.en: Position, stacks, private/community cards, betting and within-episode hand history.

action.zh: 弃牌、过牌、跟注或合法加注。
action.en: Fold, check, call or legally raise.

metrics.zh: BB/100 与按 100 手牌段 block bootstrap 区间。
metrics.en: BB/100 with block-bootstrap intervals over 100-hand episodes.

controls.zh: 盲注 1–2、每手重置 100BB；每对 20000 手，换位镜像发牌；第二次非法动作默认过牌/弃牌。
controls.en: Blinds 1–2, reset 100BB per hand; 20,000 hands per pair with mirrored deals; second invalid action defaults to check/fold.

limits.zh: 手段内历史完整提供，不视作独立记忆测试；发牌镜像不消除全部方差。
limits.en: Full within-episode history is supplied, not an isolated memory test; mirroring does not remove all variance.

basis.zh: 风险、赔率与对手下注行为共同决定资源取舍。
basis.en: Risk, odds and opponent betting determine resource trade-offs.

evidence.title: Game Arena: Strategic LLM Evaluation in Competitive Environments
evidence.excerpt: Section 2 and Appendix B distinguish Chess/Poker/Werewolf inputs, invalid-action handling and primary metrics. Added three independent protocols without inventing a cross-game total score.

task.zh: 利用讨论、投票与角色能力争取阵营胜利。

observation.zh: 按可见性过滤的公共/私有事件、角色和历史。

action.zh: 阶段限定发言、投票、查验或角色能力。

metrics.zh: GTE 分解角色贡献及 bootstrap 区间。
metrics.en: GTE role-specific contributions and bootstrap intervals.

controls.zh: 8 玩家固定基础规则；约 31500 局；固定事件权限与重试/弃权规则。
controls.en: Eight-player base rules, approximately 31,500 games, fixed visibility and retry/forfeiture rules.

limits.zh: 角色不平衡使原始胜率不可直接横比；上下文溢出会截断历史。

paragraphs.zh: Collab-Overcooked 在 Overcooked-AI 上扩展菜谱、食材和任务。两个智能体通过行动与自然语言交流完成订单，协调取料、加工和交付之间的先后依赖。
paragraphs.en: Collab-Overcooked extends Overcooked-AI with recipes, ingredients and tasks. Two agents act and communicate in natural language to coordinate dependencies between gathering, processing and delivery.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究 LLM 协作、任务分解和交流机制对执行效率的影响，分析智能体如何分工、发起协作并响应伙伴。
paragraphs.en: It supports LLM cooperation, task decomposition and communication studies, examining allocation of work and the initiation of and response to collaboration.

paragraphs.zh: 任务结果采用成功率与成功轨迹的完成时间步；协作过程采用参考动作序列相似度或冗余，以及协作发起与响应统计。
paragraphs.en: Outcomes are measured by success rate and completion timesteps on successful trajectories. Process metrics include reference-action similarity or redundancy and collaboration initiation and response statistics.

paragraphs.zh: 评测基于扩展版研究环境中的双智能体订单任务。任务、布局、伙伴与预算确定实验条件，完成时间以环境步数计量。
paragraphs.en: Evaluation covers two-agent order tasks in the extended research environment. Tasks, layouts, partners and budgets define experimental conditions, with completion time measured in environment steps.

action.zh: 密码大师给词和数量；猜词者选择词或结束回合。

metrics.zh: 红/蓝队胜率；刺客选择导致立即输局。

basis.en: Asymmetric information must be transmitted through constrained clues.

task.zh: 在收集资源与清理公共河流之间取舍，并适应不同伙伴行为。
task.en: Balance resource harvesting and public river cleaning with different co-players.

observation.zh: 局部 RGB 和配置允许的局部状态；不向策略提供 WORLD.RGB 等调试全局状态。

action.zh: 移动、转向、清理与 zap 等离散动作。
action.en: Discrete movement, turn, clean and zap actions.

metrics.zh: 焦点 Agent 的人均回报；比赛分数相对基线最好/最差回报归一化。
metrics.en: Focal per-capita return; contest score normalized to baseline best/worst returns.

controls.en: Public validation clean_up_2–8; final contest has held-out partners; pin official scenario versions.

limits.zh: 只展开 Clean Up；当前公开配置不宣称等同隐藏最终测试。高分不自动证明亲社会性。
limits.en: Only Clean Up is expanded; current public configs are not the hidden final test. High score is not automatically prosociality.

basis.en: Evaluates adaptation to co-player populations not seen in training.

basis.en: Public cleaning and private harvesting create a social dilemma.

task.en: Sustain harvestable resources by maintaining the river while adapting to unfamiliar partners.

observation.zh: 各 Agent 的局部像素与个体奖励；不是完整全局状态。
observation.en: Individual local pixels and rewards, not full global state.

action.zh: 移动、转向、采集以及清理河流等交互动作。
action.en: Movement, turning, harvesting and river-cleaning interactions.

metrics.zh: 仅焦点群体的人均累计回报，排除背景 Agent；按测试场景报告。
metrics.en: Focal per-capita return excluding background agents, reported by scenario.

controls.zh: 原实验每 substrate 训练 1B 步；固定焦点/背景采样比例、背景策略与配置版本。
controls.en: Original experiments train 1B steps per substrate; fix population mix, background policies and configuration version.

limits.zh: 与竞赛条目共用底层游戏；不能重复算作两个独立游戏。回报并非独立道德判断量表。
limits.en: Shares a game with the contest, not two independent games. Return is not a standalone moral judgment scale.

basis.zh: 陌生背景策略组成明确测试情境。
basis.en: Unfamiliar background policies define test situations.

basis.zh: 个人采集收益依赖其他 Agent 对公共河流的维护。
basis.en: Private harvesting relies on others maintaining the public river.

basis.zh: 采集与清理活动需要形成可持续的群体分工。
basis.en: Harvesting and cleaning require sustainable division of labor.

task.en: Get all teammates across the junction to opposite targets before the other team.

observation.zh: Unity 中分配给各智能体的视口；论文未固定像素尺寸。

action.zh: 移动和转向。
action.en: Move and turn.

metrics.zh: 率先全部到达的队得1，另一队得0；回合奖励及基准种群排名。
metrics.en: Winning team receives 1, other team 0; episodic reward and reference-population rank.

controls.zh: 两队各4名；图5(d)团队内协作、团队间竞争，比较5种基线。
controls.en: Two four-agent teams; Figure 5(d) cooperative within teams and competitive between teams; five baselines.

limits.zh: 仅已报告的 Crossroads 设置；排名依赖100名参考智能体，不能外推全部Unity游戏。
limits.en: Only the reported Crossroads setting; rankings depend on a 100-agent reference population, not all Unity games.

task.zh: 记住曾翻开但当前隐藏的牌，匹配全部同类。
task.en: Remember previously revealed hidden cards and match all pairs.

observation.zh: 可见棋盘及交互历史；图像/文字条件可切换。

action.zh: 每回合翻两张牌。
action.en: Flip two cards per turn.

metrics.zh: 配对比例、每对响应次数、解析错误与Memory Gap。
metrics.en: Matched fraction, responses per pair, parse errors, Memory Gap.

controls.zh: 固定预算；控制大小、图案、反馈及历史，隐藏状态oracle作对照。
controls.en: Fixed budget; vary size, pattern, feedback/history; compare hidden-state oracle.

limits.zh: 记忆与感知仍需分层分析；只映射此任务，不复制到整套所有游戏。
limits.en: Memory and perception require stratification; task-specific mapping only.

basis.zh: 必须重建不可见的身份—位置绑定，oracle差距用于区分遗忘。

label.zh: Snake 严格规则闭环控制

task.zh: 在避开墙壁、身体和障碍物的同时吃苹果。
task.en: Eat apples while avoiding walls, the snake body and obstacles.

observation.zh: 网格中的墙、蛇头、身体、食物、障碍物及当前方向。
observation.en: Grid walls, head, body, food, obstacles and current direction.

action.zh: LEFT、RIGHT、UP、DOWN 四个方向动作；禁止反向。
action.en: LEFT, RIGHT, UP and DOWN, with reversal prohibited.

metrics.zh: 每个苹果加一分并增长；报告环境得分及学习曲线 Avg、Max、AUC+。
metrics.en: Each apple adds one point and increases length; report environment scores and curve Avg, Max and AUC+.

controls.zh: 严格评测遇碰撞终止、上限 64 步；30 次探索，每 3 次探索评测 3 局，评测种子分离且不反馈结果。
controls.en: Strict collision termination with a sixty-four-step cap; thirty exploration episodes, three evaluation games every three episodes, disjoint seeds and no evaluation feedback.

limits.zh: 仅覆盖 Snake；探索时碰撞为 no-op 与严格评测不同，曲线汇总并非独立能力。
limits.en: Covers Snake only. Exploration collision no-ops differ from strict evaluation; curve aggregates are not separate capabilities.

basis.zh: 方向选择、避碰与得分直接检验闭环控制。
basis.en: Direction selection, collision avoidance and score directly assess closed-loop control.

basis.zh: 分离种子及更严格终止规则检验同一游戏内的转移。
basis.en: Disjoint seeds and stricter termination test within-game transfer.

evidence.title: S3Gym, Table 2 and Appendix A.4
evidence.excerpt: Snake exposes a grid and four directional moves. Apples add score and length. Strict evaluation terminates on collisions and forbids reversal; the step cap is sixty-four. Exploration and evaluation use disjoint seeds.

basis.zh: 附录A表8及逐游戏模板明确Tetris落块、Minesweeper揭开/标记、Nullify合并、文字PvZ部署与Trust Evolution合作/背叛；动作改变环境并返回后续状态。表2给出探索/严格评价配置和步数，按环境分数、Avg/Max/AUC+评价；不冒充原版实时游戏。
basis.en: Appendix A/Table 8 and game templates specify Tetris placements, Minesweeper reveal/flag, Nullify transformations, text-PvZ planting and Trust Evolution choices. basis.zh: Chess在这里是隐藏移动规则下的棋子下一位置预测，不是国际象棋对局。附录A.2要求从给定棋盘序列预测坐标，按位置预测计分；可确认状态预测评价用途。文档虽置于多步探索框架，但未核实预测会改变棋盘转移，因此不计在线控制任务。
basis.en: Chess here is hidden-rule piece-position prediction, not chess play. Appendix A.2 asks for next-position coordinates from a supplied board sequence and scores predictions. This confirms state-prediction evaluation; the multi-step framework alone does not verify that answers control board transitions, so online control is not counted.

evidence.title: S3Gym: Can LLMs Turn Self-Testing and Self-Judging into Self-Improvement?
evidence.excerpt: S3Gym separates permissive exploration from held-out tests; self-testing, self-judging, and improvement are distinct.

evidence.title: S3Gym: Can LLMs Turn Self-Testing and Self-Judging into Self-Improvement?
evidence.excerpt: Tables 2/3 and Appendix A specify actions and easy/strict splits: thirty exploration episodes, three test episodes every three, disjoint seeds and no test feedback. Avg/Max/AUC+ aggregate checkpoints; per-game reward formulas remain needed for capability units.

evidence.title: S3Gym, Table 2 and Appendix A.4
evidence.excerpt: Snake exposes a grid and four directional moves. Apples add score and length. Strict evaluation terminates on collisions and forbids reversal; the step cap is sixty-four. Exploration and evaluation use disjoint seeds.

followup.noteZh: 表 2/3 与附录 A 核实七游戏动作表示和探索/严格测试差异：30 探索局、每 3 局测 3 局、种子隔离，测试轨迹不反馈学习；Avg/Max/AUC+ 是跨 checkpoint 汇总。尚需逐游戏环境评分公式，暂不据汇总曲线生成泛化/记忆能力单位。
followup.noteEn: Tables 2/3 and Appendix A specify actions and easy/strict splits: thirty exploration episodes, three test episodes every three, disjoint seeds and no test feedback. Avg/Max/AUC+ aggregate checkpoints; per-game reward formulas remain needed for capability units.

task.zh: 完成各游戏指定里程碑或提升指定数值目标；两款Grim Tales只评初始找物场景。
task.en: Complete specified milestones or improve designated numeric goals; the two Grim Tales games evaluate initial hidden-object scenes only.

observation.zh: 游戏屏幕与近期轨迹，额外记忆依harness而定。
observation.en: Game screen and recent trajectories, with harness-dependent memory.

action.zh: GUI点击、键盘等原生游戏交互。
action.en: Native GUI clicks, keyboard inputs, and game interactions.

metrics.zh: 离散里程碑完成比例；六款连续数值目标按人类参考归一化；动作数另列。
metrics.en: Discrete milestone completion; six continuous-goal scores normalized against human references; action counts reported separately.

controls.zh: 每游戏固定目标及最大步数；近期10条轨迹；原文仅单次运行。
controls.en: Fixed per-game goals/action caps, latest ten trajectories; single runs in paper.

limits.zh: CUA-as-a-Judge存在判定误差；无严格反应时，不计即时控制代表性。 任务跨度不一，不能把完整故事线或记忆能力统一复制到34款。
limits.en: CUA-as-a-Judge may err; no strict reaction timing, so not representative real-time control. Heterogeneous task scopes do not justify copying full-story or memory labels to all thirty-four titles.

limits.zh: 有效动作提取使用世界状态变化搜索，不能与完全自由命令或未见游戏结果直接横比。

profile.summary: VISTA

basis.zh: 规则与目标起初不提供，动作反馈用于发现可用机制和目标。
basis.en: Rules and goals are initially withheld; action feedback is used to discover mechanics and objectives.

evidence.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
evidence.excerpt: Section 4 evaluates twenty-five public ARC-AGI-3 games with undisclosed rules/goals, image observations, available actions, level completion and relative human action efficiency.

label.zh: 公开 ARC-AGI-3 交互规则发现

task.zh: 通过反馈探索未说明的规则与目标，完成关卡。
task.en: Explore feedback to discover unspecified rules/goals and complete levels.

observation.zh: 当前画面及可用动作；可检索历史帧、像素和代理自己的笔记。
observation.en: Current image and available actions, with optional historical frames, pixel inspection and agent notes.

action.zh: play执行环境提供的动作；inspect/read_pixels为观察工具。
action.en: play executes available environment actions; inspect/read_pixels provide observations.

metrics.zh: RHAE、完成游戏比例与动作总数；未完成关卡记零。
metrics.en: RHAE, game completion fraction and total actions; unfinished levels receive zero.

controls.zh: 仅论文25个公开游戏；保持相同harness，模型推理强度、视觉表示和上下文预算分别报告。
controls.en: Only the twenty-five public games; fix harness and report model effort, visual representation and context budget separately.

limits.zh: 探索映射依据全套公开任务明确未给出的规则/目标，不给各游戏复制记忆、规划等其他能力；不含静态BabyVision。
limits.en: Exploration follows the explicitly undisclosed goals/rules of this public task set; no copied memory/planning labels per game; static BabyVision excluded.

bibliography.name: XLand-100B
bibliography.title: XLand-100B: A Large-Scale Multi-Task Dataset for In-Context Reinforcement Learning
bibliography.authors: Alexander Nikulin; Ilya Zisman; Alexey Zemtsov; Vladislav Kurenkov

basis.zh: XLand-100B 不仅含学习历史数据，还实际比较 common in-context RL baselines 的泛化。
basis.en: XLand-100B not only stores learning histories but evaluates common in-context RL baselines for generalization.

basis.zh: 原文 §2.1 选择 AD 与 DPT 为主要基线：分别从交互历史预测下一动作、从上下文预测最优动作，属于动作示范监督/蒸馏。
basis.en: Section 2.1 selects AD and DPT as main baselines: supervised next-action prediction from interaction histories and optimal-action prediction from context, establishing policy imitation/distillation.

basis.zh: Shapes 给定0/1矩阵中的几何形状并要求从选项辨识，按正确答案比例评测。虽然代码封装了 guess()，一次作答即结束，本文用途属于固定输入的识别评测，不计为多步在线控制。
basis.en: Shapes presents a geometric form in a binary matrix and scores classification accuracy. A guess() wrapper does not establish sequential control: one answer ends the item. Its documented use is offline recognition evaluation.

evidence.title: ChildPlay — Methods, Appendix A.5 and LCL experiments
evidence.excerpt: Shapes scores fixed matrix recognition answers; LCL checks 800 valid/invalid constructs and 100 model-generated constructs, without sequential environment control.

basis.zh: LCL 用800个预生成的有效/无效构造做判别，并要求每个模型生成100个构造，随后按连接和不重叠规则检查正确率。这是静态判别/生成评测，不是操作商业 LEGO 游戏或逐步推进环境。
basis.en: LCL evaluates 800 pregenerated valid/invalid structures and 100 generated structures per model using connectivity/overlap checks. These are static classification/generation tests, not a commercial LEGO game or sequential environment control.

basis.zh: 摘要、§3 与附录实际训练并比较多种 RL 解题策略。

agentReview.noteEn: Image/state observation modes support RL; without documented language-conditioned agents, VLM/VLA are not automatically added.

task.zh: 根据激光反馈定位隐藏球
task.en: Infer hidden balls from laser feedback

observation.zh: 棋盘内部离散状态；可选 RGB 像素。
observation.en: Discrete board state; optional RGB pixels.

action.zh: 该游戏的离散键盘动作；具体键位见附录 E 表 5。
action.en: Puzzle-specific discrete keyboard actions; Appendix E Table 5.

metrics.zh: 完成率、成功回合步数；参考人类与最优步数上界。
metrics.en: Completion rate and successful episode length; human and optimal-step upper-bound references.

controls.zh: 固定难度与尺寸；5 个训练种子，每策略 1,000 测试局；10,000 步上限；报告观察、mask 与奖励配置。
controls.en: Fix difficulty and size; 5 training seeds, 1,000 evaluation episodes per policy, 10,000-step cap; report observation, masks and rewards.

limits.zh: 规则推理与接口操作共同影响成绩；不单独证明记忆、实时控制或长时程能力。
limits.en: Scores combine rule reasoning and interface actions; they do not isolate memory, real-time control or long-horizon competence.

basis.zh: 通过主动试探反馈消除隐藏配置的假设。
basis.en: Active probes reduce uncertainty about the hidden configuration.

basis.zh: 任务目标为“根据激光反馈定位隐藏球”；完成率衡量在规则约束下得到有效解，归类为任务关联而非隔离的推理因果测量。
basis.en: The objective is to infer hidden balls from laser feedback. Completion measures a valid rule-constrained solution; this is a task association, not an isolated causal reasoning measurement.

paragraphs.zh: MiniGrid 提供导航、取物、开门和记忆等网格世界任务，智能体依据任务提示与局部观测操作物体。例如 Memory 任务要求记住起点物体，再穿过走廊选择匹配目标。
paragraphs.en: MiniGrid provides grid-world tasks for navigation, retrieval, doors and memory, using mission text and local observations. Memory requires retaining an initial object cue and later selecting a matching destination.

paragraphs.zh: 用于研究部分可观测决策、记忆和目标执行。地图结构、可见范围与任务难度可配置，便于构造受控实验与算法消融。
paragraphs.en: It supports partial observability, memory and goal execution through configurable map structures, visibility and difficulty, enabling controlled experiments and ablations.

paragraphs.zh: 指标由具体环境定义。Memory 成功时获得随步数折减的奖励、失败时为零，回报同时反映目标达成与路径效率。
paragraphs.en: Metrics are environment-specific. Memory assigns step-discounted reward on success and zero on failure, capturing completion and path efficiency.

paragraphs.zh: 本概述的任务示例来自 MiniGrid，同一档案另关联 MiniWorld。MiniGrid 默认使用网格编码，RGB 与全可观测等包装器提供其他输入设置；环境 ID、包装器和步数上限确定具体协议。
paragraphs.en: Examples here concern MiniGrid; the archive also links MiniWorld. Default grid encodings and RGB or fully observable wrappers provide distinct inputs. Environment IDs, wrappers and episode limits define each protocol.

basis.zh: 官方实验目录明确每任务以 sweep.py 固定配置、analysis.py 定义评分。保留已核验 Memory Length/Deep Sea 两项，并强调需绑定相应 sweep 和评分；不把套件雷达图平均值当任意子任务能力。 本轮归属复核：仅关联bsuite明确的Memory Length诊断环境，难度长度/大小是参数扫描。 仅关联bsuite明确的Deep Sea诊断环境，难度长度/大小是参数扫描。
basis.en: The official experiment directory assigns configurations to sweep.py and scoring to analysis.py. Retain the verified Memory Length/Deep Sea scope, tied to those files; suite radar averages do not label arbitrary subtasks. Routing review: Route only bsuite’s explicit Memory Length diagnostic environment; lengths/sizes are parameter sweeps. Route only bsuite’s explicit Deep Sea diagnostic environment; lengths/sizes are parameter sweeps.

gameAttribution.noteZh: 完整列出 17 项 GameOpt 起始项目及 21 项公开 GameGen 示例；97 项 GameGen 仍为部分展开，50 个 GameFix 关卡未公开。父集合涵盖三个轨道，Gold Games 专指 GameFix。
gameAttribution.noteEn: Includes all 17 GameOpt starting projects and 21 public GameGen examples. The 97-task GameGen inventory is only partially expanded, and the 50 GameFix levels are private. The parent collection covers all three tracks; Gold Games specifically denotes GameFix.

profile.summary: GameXpert-Bench: How Far Are Coding Agents from Expert Game Development?

basis.zh: GameGen、GameFix、GameOpt 三条开发轨道，评价生成质量、缺陷修复和跨轮优化保真度；不映射到玩家能力。
basis.en: GameGen, GameFix and GameOpt assess creation, repair and iterative optimization fidelity, not player capabilities.

evidence.title: GameXpert-Bench: How Far Are Coding Agents from Expert Game Development?
evidence.excerpt: GameGen, GameFix and GameOpt assess creation, repair and iterative optimization fidelity, not player capabilities.

attribution.noteZh: 完整列出 17 项 GameOpt 起始项目及 21 项公开 GameGen 示例；97 项 GameGen 仍为部分展开，50 个 GameFix 关卡未公开。父集合涵盖三个轨道，Gold Games 专指 GameFix。
attribution.noteEn: Includes all 17 GameOpt starting projects and 21 public GameGen examples. The 97-task GameGen inventory is only partially expanded, and the 50 GameFix levels are private. The parent collection covers all three tracks; Gold Games specifically denotes GameFix.

evidence.title: GameXpert-Bench: How Far Are Coding Agents from Expert Game Development?
evidence.excerpt: Appendix C Table 17 names 17 GameOpt projects; Appendix A Tables 7–9 disclose 21 GameGen examples.

evidence.title: Official GameXpert repository
evidence.excerpt: Only a release scaffold is public; benchmark task files are not released.
